title: The Listening Cellar
author: Sebastian Sandoval
blurb: Vesper Thornbury, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
